lines.trans: A whole hour has passed already!
So what? This is complex work.
You are taking very long to fix my tank.
Do you think this is done in fifteen minutes?
This is sophisticated modern equipment!
I took it apart myself before.
One thing is you, another is a grown adult.
Does it hurt you here?
No, it just tickles.
Why are you hovering over me?
Uncle Arkady will fix everything and call you.
Go into the room and don't get in the way!

взрослый.gloss: adult, grown-up; (as a noun) a grown-up

meanings.note: as a noun, often plural: взрослые = grown-ups

examples.text: Маленькие умеют терпеть, а взрослые нет, понял?
examples.trans: Little ones can hold on, but grown-ups can't, got it?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'сделать'.

examples.trans: Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

meanings.note: много дел = a lot to do

examples.trans: I have a lot to do.

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('other, another, different').

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

meanings.note: masculine, but declined like a feminine noun in -я

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

мешать.gloss: to be in the way, to disturb

meanings.en: to be in the way, to hinder

examples.trans: The radiators are in the way.

examples.text: Филиппыч, миксер проехать не может. Радиаторы мешают.
examples.trans: Filippych, the mixer truck can't get through. The radiators are in the way.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'minute' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: I'll be there in ten minutes.

examples.text: Ладно, будь там. Через десять минут буду.
examples.trans: All right, stay there. I'll be there in ten minutes.

meanings.note: смеяться над = to laugh at; form надо before мной

examples.trans: The lamp is above the table.

examples.text: За поведение? Вы смеётесь надо мной?
examples.trans: For my conduct? Are you laughing at me?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
agrees in gender and case with the noun

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'звать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to call, summon', paired with 'звать'.

examples.text: Дядя Аркадий всё починит и позовёт.
examples.trans: Uncle Arkady will fix everything and call you.

examples.text: Главное, чтобы она не позвала директора.
examples.trans: The main thing is that she does not call the director.

examples.text: Дядя Аркадий всё починит и позовёт.
examples.trans: Uncle Arkady will fix everything and call you.

пройти.gloss: to go through, to pass; to come along

meanings.note: about a feeling or pain: потом пройдёт = it'll pass
'Пройдёмте' = let's go, an official's polite order

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

examples.text: Да я три года грузчиком работал. Тут дел на пятнадцать минут.
examples.trans: Oh, I worked as a mover for three years. This is fifteen minutes' work.

meanings.note: Prefix 'рас-' ('apart, un-, thoroughly') indicates distribution or intensive action (stem 'кручивать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to unscrew, take apart', paired with 'раскрутить'.

examples.trans: I took it apart myself before.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ложный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('complicated, difficult').

examples.trans: Danila, let's go. Look, there's nothing complicated.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'овременный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('modern, contemporary').

examples.trans: There will be a modern, beautiful complex there.
